task.description:
Execute fn:git-merge per docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md.

This is the FINAL step of WF-03. Per ORCHESTRATOR.md section 8, this is a HARD GATE.

Steps:
1. Check branch status: git branch --show-current (must be feature/WF03-gh376-20260804)
2. Fetch and rebase on origin/main: git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main
3. Resolve any conflicts if needed
4. Push: git push origin feature/WF03-gh376-20260804
5. Create PR via gh pr create with the prepared body
6. Merge PR: gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
7. Verify cleanup: git fetch origin && git branch -r | grep feature/WF03-gh376-20260804 || echo Branch deleted
8. Return to main: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
9. Verify: git branch --show-current (must be main), git status (must be clean)

Result MUST contain: branch_name, commit_sha_list, remote_branch, pr_url, push_status: ok, confirmation that local repo is on main with clean working tree.
